title: Used Claude Opus 5.5 to make my love letter to Stick RPG. A few months ago I was just fucking around with a $20 subscription.
author: jewfro7861
selftext:
Not the most visually complex game to pull off, but honestly, that's part of why I started with this idea.

Stick RPG was one of my favorite games growing up, and I wanted to make my own ridiculous little love letter to it.

So far, so good. Nobody has sent my mother death threats over me using AI, and I've actually had quite a few random people sink some real hours into the game. Some have played for over 20 hours, which still blows my mind.

This literally started a few months ago with a $20 subscription and me fucking around to see what I could build.

I know it's not some massive commercial success. I'm still a tiny indie developer figuring this shit out. But I wanted to remind some other people here that it's absolutely possible to make something people genuinely enjoy using AI, especially when you're putting your own ideas, humor, and personality into it.

Anyway, here's the trailer for Stick Life: The Daily Grind. Hope it gives somebody else the motivation to make that weird game idea they've been sitting on.
